      "type": "question",

      "text": "whether m_best_invalid fails to be set properly when pindex is in the main chain",
      "quote": "I think this can fail to set `m_best_invalid` properly since `to_mark_failed` walks backwards (if `pindex` is in the main chain) and then `UpdateBestInvalid` is called after looping?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it is pre-existing; reviewer agreed it can be addressed in a follow-up",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2750598046"],
      "other_replies": [],

    {
      "id": "rc:2720846535",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "whether the second call to UpdateBestInvalid is redundant with InvalidBlockFound in ConnectTip",
      "quote": "I think this update is already handled by `InvalidBlockFound()`, called from within `ConnectTip()`, so this second call is maybe unnecessary?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "Crypt-iQ explained the difference and frankomosh accepted",
      "author_replies": [],

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "InvalidateBlock misses SetBlockFailureFlags and RecalculateBestHeader when the target block is not in the active chain",
      "quote": "for the case where to_mark_failed is out-of-chain, I think it's missing SetBlockFailureFlags & RecalculateBestHeader?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author restored missing calls in ff06c05 with test; reviewer crACKed",
      "author_replies": ["c:5344639095", "rc:2798475012", "rc:3814485744"],

      "id": "r:3997887968",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "combine the two iterations over the block index into a single pass",
      "quote": "wondering if it’s also possible to avoid looping over the block index twice and instead combine this into a single pass?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that optimizing this rare error path is unnecessary",
      "author_replies": ["c:5344639095"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5344639095",
      "status_by_quote": "I didn't do that here - I feel like it's not really necessary to optimize too much"

    {
      "id": "rc:3256954484",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Changes to InvalidateBlock log prefix and format may break external log monitoring",
      "quote": "might silently break any log monitoring on the old string.",

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",

      "kind": "approach",
